meta.title: Professional Project Archive
meta.description: Structured project history for the portfolio. Enrich summaries, technologies, categories, featured flags, and live links as details become available.

projects.name: Darpon LMS
projects.summary: Darpon is a full-featured LMS web application built with Laravel and React. It provides the core functionality for an online learning management platform while also supporting online book sales.
projects.description: Darpon LMS is a comprehensive learning management and online book-commerce platform built with Laravel, React, and Inertia.js. It brings course delivery, educational content, and book sales into a unified digital experience for learners and administrators. Laravel handles the application's business logic and server-side workflows, while React and Tailwind CSS provide a responsive, accessible interface. MySQL stores structured learning and commerce data, with Redis supporting caching and efficient background processing.

projects.name: Trading Chart
projects.summary: Trading Chart is a full-featured learning management and live-streaming platform built for delivering interactive online education. It provides comprehensive LMS functionality, secure payment processing, AI-powered chat assistance, and real-time WebSocket support using Laravel Reverb.
projects.description: Trading Chart is a full-featured learning management and live-streaming platform designed for interactive online education. It combines course delivery, secure payment workflows, AI-assisted chat, and real-time user support within one connected system. Laravel powers the core application services and WebSocket communication, while React provides a responsive interface for learners and administrators. PostgreSQL manages the platform's structured data, and the AI MCP integration extends the learning experience with intelligent, contextual assistance.

projects.name: Paikari World - E-commerce
projects.summary: Paikari World is a full-featured e-commerce platform built with Laravel and React. It provides a robust and scalable solution for online shopping, with features such as whole selling settings, inventory management, payment gateway integration, and more.
projects.description: Paikari World is a scalable wholesale e-commerce platform developed with Laravel, React, and Inertia.js. It supports product catalog management, wholesale pricing configurations, inventory control, customer ordering, and payment gateway integration through a cohesive application experience. Laravel manages the commerce rules and backend workflows, while React and Tailwind CSS deliver a responsive storefront and administration interface. PostgreSQL provides reliable relational data storage, with Redis improving caching and background task performance.

projects.name: U.S. Real Estate Platform
projects.summary: A U.S.-focused real estate platform built with Laravel, React, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, featuring web-scraping workflows for collecting and organizing property data.
projects.description: This U.S.-focused real estate platform brings property information into a structured, searchable digital experience. Laravel powers the backend business logic and data-processing workflows, while React and TypeScript provide a responsive, maintainable frontend. PostgreSQL stores normalized property and listing data, and purpose-built web-scraping workflows collect information from external sources for centralized management. The architecture separates data acquisition, server-side processing, and presentation concerns, creating a dependable foundation for managing and exploring real estate listings.

projects.name: Magic LMS
projects.summary: Magic LMS is an AI-oriented learning management system for creating, delivering, and monetizing online education through multimedia courses, live classes, assessments, subscriptions, and collaborative learning tools.
projects.description: Magic LMS is a complete e-learning platform designed for individual instructors, coaching centers, training institutes, and organizations. Its role-based experience gives administrators control over users, instructors, subscriptions, payments, and platform settings; enables instructors to build video, text, PDF, quiz, and Zoom-based courses; and allows students to purchase courses, track progress, download materials, participate in discussions, and earn certificates. DeepInfra-powered AI tools support modern content workflows, while private messaging and a community forum encourage engagement between learners and instructors. Built with Laravel, React, and Inertia.js on PHP 8 and MySQL 8, the system combines secure server-side business logic with a fast, responsive application interface.

projects.name: AI Automation for WordPress
projects.summary: A self-hosted WordPress automation plugin that connects website and Facebook workflows through n8n while synchronizing stock, inventory, and order data across connected systems.
projects.description: AI Automation for WordPress is a custom plugin and workflow solution designed to reduce repetitive website and social media operations. The plugin connects WordPress with a self-hosted n8n environment, allowing site events and business data to trigger manageable automation workflows. It coordinates Facebook automation and keeps stock, inventory, and order information synchronized between connected services. WordPress and PHP provide the site-side integration layer, while REST APIs and webhooks enable reliable communication with n8n and the Facebook API. The self-hosted architecture gives the business greater control over workflow execution, operational data, and future automation extensions.

projects.name: Paymongo WooCommerce Payment Gateway
projects.summary: A custom WooCommerce payment gateway plugin that integrates PayMongo's API directly into the checkout process, enabling the client's store to securely accept and manage online payments.
projects.description: This project delivered a purpose-built PayMongo payment gateway for a WooCommerce store that could not rely on an official WordPress integration. Working from the client's API documentation and credentials, I developed a custom plugin that connects WooCommerce checkout requests with PayMongo's payment services. The integration translates payment responses into the appropriate WooCommerce order states, provides customers with clear transaction feedback, and gives the store owner a practical payment workflow within the existing administration environment. The result removed the platform-integration gap and enabled the client to accept PayMongo payments directly through their online store.

projects.name: NMI & Konnektive CRM Integration
projects.summary: A custom API integration connecting NMI payments with Konnektive CRM, automatically transferring customer, order, and transaction data for centralized analysis and marketing operations.
projects.description: This project connected the NMI payment platform with Konnektive CRM to create a continuous flow of e-commerce data between payment processing and customer management. After a customer placed an order or completed a payment, the integration collected the relevant customer, order, and transaction information and transferred it to Konnektive through its API. The synchronized records gave the client a centralized view of purchasing activity for business analysis, customer segmentation, and performance tracking. With this data available in the CRM, the client could develop targeted offers, support advertising campaigns, and make more informed marketing decisions without manually moving information between platforms.

projects.name: LinkedIn & GamiPress Integration
projects.summary: A verified social-reward integration that connects LinkedIn with GamiPress, awarding redeemable coins only after a user's shared blog post has been successfully confirmed.
projects.description: The client operated several blogging websites where registered users could share published content, earn coins through GamiPress, and later convert those rewards into cash. The original implementation granted coins as soon as a user clicked the LinkedIn share button, even when the post was never published, making the reward process unreliable. I integrated LinkedIn APIs and webhooks to verify that a share was successfully submitted before triggering the corresponding GamiPress reward. By connecting verified LinkedIn activity with the correct user and blog post, the new workflow protects reward integrity, reduces unverified coin claims, and provides a dependable foundation for managing influencer participation across the client's websites.

projects.name: Maildoll - Email & SMS Marketing SaaS
projects.summary: Contributed to Maildoll, a self-hosted SaaS platform for creating, automating, sending, and analyzing large-scale email and SMS marketing campaigns.
projects.description: I contributed to the development and ongoing improvement of Maildoll, a self-hosted email and SMS marketing SaaS application built for businesses and marketing service providers. The platform enables users to manage unlimited contacts, organize segmented lists, create responsive email and SMS templates, schedule campaigns, process bulk messages through queues, and monitor delivery, opens, clicks, bounces, and campaign performance. It supports multiple SMTP services and SMS gateways, autoresponders, subscription plans, payment gateways, user limits, multi-language configuration, and team-based account management. Built with Laravel, PHP, and MySQL, Maildoll gives organizations control over their marketing infrastructure while providing the operational tools required to run and monetize email and SMS services.
